## Checklist
- [ ] Tests pasan localmente (`uv run pytest`)
- [ ] Ruff pasa (`uv run ruff check .`)
- [ ] Gate verde (`bash bin/gate.sh`)

- [ ] CHANGELOG.md y versión intactos (los genera PSR al mergear)
